interface.longDescription:
LoomaScale connects Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads and marketing data to ChatGPT and Codex. Audit spend and tracking, and research competitors' public Google and Meta ads. Audits are read-only. You approve campaign changes.

What can I do with Google Ads?
Audit campaigns, ads, keywords and search terms for wasted spend and negative keywords. Review conversion tracking, disapprovals and budget pacing; compare periods, devices and locations. Research keyword ideas, search volume, competition and bid estimates. Create and manage Search, Shopping and Performance Max campaigns, ads, keywords, bids and budgets after approval. New campaigns start paused.

What can I learn from competitors' ads?
Research public Google, Facebook and Instagram ads in Google Ads Transparency Center and Meta Ad Library. Compare creatives, messaging, offers, calls to action and disclosed landing pages with sources, dates and coverage limits. Sign in to LoomaScale without connecting an ad account. Budgets, conversions and ROAS are private.

What can I do with Meta Ads, Facebook Ads and Instagram Ads?
Audit campaigns, ad sets and ads. Analyze spend, reach, frequency, conversions, cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS) and creative fatigue signals. Compare placements and audiences where available; diagnose delivery and pacing. Create and manage campaigns and ads on request and approval.

What can I do with Meta Pixel (Facebook Pixel)?
Review connected datasets/pixels, event activity over the last 1-7 days and Event Match Quality. Compare browser Pixel and server-side Conversions API counts; inspect available deduplication, match-key and upload-delay diagnostics. Checks are read-only: they do not install pixels, send events or change tracking settings. Permissions can limit diagnostics.

What can I do with TikTok Ads?
Audit spend and cost per conversion for manual and Smart+ campaigns. Compare 2-second and 6-second video views, completion rates and audience segments. After a preview and your approval, adjust budgets or eligible ad group bids, or pause, resume or rename existing campaigns, ad groups and ads.

What can I do with LinkedIn Ads?
Review campaign and creative performance, leads, wasted spend and professional demographics. Reporting is read-only; demographics are approximate and may be delayed.

What can I do with Google Analytics 4 (GA4)?
Analyze traffic, landing pages, key events, revenue, funnels and attribution. Compare outcomes with ad reports. Manage key events, event create/edit rules, enhanced measurement, data redaction and web streams after a dry run and approval. Rules affect future events, not historical data. Tools cannot install tags or delete properties or streams.

What can I do with Google Tag Manager (GTM)?
Audit containers, tags, triggers, variables, duplicate tags, consent configuration and unpublished changes. Configuration checks do not verify live tag firing.

What can I do with Google Search Console (GSC)?
Analyze queries, pages, clicks, impressions, CTR and average position. Investigate traffic declines, find keyword opportunities, inspect indexing and review sitemaps. Submit or remove sitemaps and add or remove properties on request; property removal needs confirmation. Google's API cannot request indexing; use URL Inspection in Search Console.

What can I do with Google Merchant Center (GMC)?
Review account health, product approvals, disapprovals and issues. Analyze product performance, price benchmarks and competitor visibility where available.

Why did my marketing results change?
Compare connected sources over compatible periods to explain likely drivers and prioritize fixes. Ad-platform conversions and GA4 outcomes are not deduplicated sales.

How do I get started?
Connect your accounts in LoomaScale. GA4, GTM, GSC and GMC changes require approval. LoomaScale checks daily ad budgets against your cap. GA4 writes require analytics.edit and property edit permission. Reconnect older read-only connections.
